data.name: AI Suit
data.description: The suit - full body and head bodysuit, made of thin, nano-metal plates, covering user's body, making their outside, looking like one of female android. Surface part of the suit is fully customizable, allowing user to take any appearance of their desired anime character. All kinds of modifications, of the suit, or even user's inner body included.
